{{Quote|Okay, ''verd'ika'', is it ''gi'' dumpling soup, or red gourd?''"<br />"''Gourd, please.|The bartender and Fi Skirata|<ref name="O66" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] worked as a '''bartender''' at a [[Enceri cantina|cantina]] in the small [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Enceri]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. An elderly woman by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] was lean and gaunt, and spoke both [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and the Mandalorian [[Language/Legends|language]] of [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']].<ref name="O66" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the bartender waited on the former [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]]-turned-Mandalorian [[Fi Skirata]]. Though initially suspicious of Skirata as a stranger to Enceri who didn't speak ''Mando'a'' as the town's residents predominantly did, upon seeing the [[Mir'shupur sigil|''mir'shupur'' sigil]] on the young man's [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] that indicated he had suffered a [[Brain/Legends|brain]] injury, the elderly bartender softened and kindly took his order for two bowls of [[Red gourd soup|soup]] and two mugs of [[Black ale/Legends|ale]] for himself and his girlfriend, [[Parja Bralor]]. Skirata mentally likened the woman's gaunt face to someone who made a habit of sucking the juice from [[sourcane]] for fun; nevertheless, he courteously [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|paid]] for his order, and the female bartender delivered it to the table Skirata had taken with Bralor.<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unnamed bartender at the Enceri cantina first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' novel [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[September 16]], [[2008]].
